headline: Red Sox split twin bill against Yankees as arson squad ignites
morning_brew: Saturday was a total rollercoaster at the Fens, and frankly, I'm exhausted just thinking about it. We looked like a championship ballclub in the opener, shutting out the Yankees 6-0 behind a beautiful six-inning gem from Bennett, but the nightcap was an absolute train wreck. Giving up nine runs to New York is the kind of disastah that ruins a perfectly good weekend, and watching that five-run eighth inning was like watching a slow-motion car crash. My neighbor Rick is already deep into his umpire dossier, convinced the strike zone was rigged, but even his conspiracies can't hide the fact that our pitching just imploded.

The bullpen, or as I’m now calling them, the arson squad, really put on a clinic in the wrong direction during that second game. Bello and Burgos just didn't have it, and before we knew it, the game was out of hand. It's a split that stings because we had a chance to really put some pressure on them in the standings, but instead, we're left scratching our heads. My ma watched until the seventh inning before she told me the team looked like they were playing in quicksand, and at this point, I’m not sure I can disagree with her assessment.

We have to turn the page immediately for Sunday's finale, and the good news is that Roman Anthony and Trevor Story are back in the mix to help stabilize the lineup. We need that jolt of energy, especially after a long, frustrating day of baseball. I'm putting a small deposit back into the Duck Boat fund just in case we can manufacture a series win, but the boys in pinstripes aren't gonna make it easy. We need to lock in, stop giving away free bases, and remind them that we aren't going anywhere.

news_digest.headline: Roman Anthony, Trevor Story to rejoin Red Sox for finale vs. Yankees
news_digest.dans_take: About damn time the cavalry arrived before we completely flatlined in the standings.

news_digest.headline: Why Drake Maye didn't play preseason; will it matter in Week 1?
news_digest.dans_take: If he comes out firing against Seattle, nobody will care about the preseason, but it’s a big gamble.

trend_watch.trend: 6.0 scoreless innings with 7 strikeouts in game one
trend_watch.dans_take: If this man could pitch every single day, I’d finally be able to sleep through the night without a double shot of espresso.

trend_watch.trend: Allowed 5 runs in 2.1 innings of work during the nightcap
trend_watch.dans_take: I haven't seen a flame-out this bad since my cousin Jimmy tried to deep-fry a turkey in the middle of his living room.
He’s swinging at air like he’s trying to swat a mosquito that isn't even there.
